---
title: "M: colour options"
description: "A dark viewer from the `backdrop`, `caption-background`, `caption-color` and `link-color` options, with no CSS."
format:
  html:
    code-tools: true
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  backdrop: "#000"
  caption-background: "#000"
  caption-color: "#eee"
  link-color: "#9cf"
---

::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page **sets the viewer's colours from its YAML header**, with no CSS:
a black backdrop and caption band, light caption text and light blue
links. Every image on the page gets them. Each option sets one of the
viewer's CSS variables; [N: css-class and CSS](n-css-class.html) sets the
same variables from a stylesheet, for some pages only.
:::

## 1. Marked image {#c1 expect-open="panzoom" expect-overlay="rgb(0, 0, 0)" expect-band="rgb(0, 0, 0)"}

![A marked image, with a [link](https://quarto.org) in its caption.](../../images/mv-0.jpg){.panzoom}
